text: Turmeric extract can add to the blood-thinning effect of warfarin — case reports describe increased bleeding or a higher INR when the two are combined.

text: Curcumin's mild blood-thinning effect could theoretically add to apixaban's, though this pairing is less studied than curcumin with warfarin.
Piperine (black pepper extract) slows an enzyme in the gut wall that also processes some statins, which could raise blood levels of the statin. Human data on this specific pairing is limited.
src: Lab and animal studies; limited human data

text: Vitamin K works against warfarin directly — it's the same pathway warfarin blocks — so a vitamin K2 supplement can make warfarin noticeably less effective at thinning your blood. This is one of the best-documented supplement-drug interactions there is.
src: Extensive clinical literature; warfarin prescribing information
